messages:
maria: Planning to push a scaling policy change to reserved-gpu-pool-3 tonight. Target start 02:30 UTC. Who can lead/run and who will stand by for rollback?

devon: I can run the deploy. Change is mainly: max_nodes -> 48, min_nodes -> 8, scale_step -> +4, scale_down_cooldown -> 300s. Will do dry-run first.

aj: I can take on smoke tests and watch the dashboards. Can we do a 10% canary first and hold for ~20m? :thumbsup:

maria: Yes — canary 10% for pool-variant v2. After ~20m check p50/p95 latency, GPU util, and queue depth. If all good, ramp to 100% in 3 steps.

sam: I'll standby for rollback. If anything spikes, I'll run rollback. Rollback quick command: `infractl pools rollback reserved-gpu-pool-3 --to=previous` (keeping logs).

devon: Also note: do not change model pins or KV cache settings in this deploy. Canary job created: infra/jobs/canary-reserved-pool-1781234567 (runs gen + embed probes).

aj: Quick smoke checklist I'll run once canary is live:
1) small text gen latency p50 < 150ms
2) p95 < 600ms
3) token throughput >= target baseline
4) no OOM or implicit backpressure on pods
5) errors/sec <= baseline + 5%
I'll post a short summary at 20m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Oncall for window: aj. Pager: https://pager.example/teams/infra-oncall

maria: Good. Devon — please run dry-run at 02:10 UTC and then start canary at 02:30. Aj will validate; Sam will be ready to rollback.

sam: Confirmed, I'm on standby and reachable on pager and Slack DM. +1 to canary.

aj: I'll also create temporary alerts for GPU throttling and autoscaler errors and snapshot current policy to S3 before changes:
`aws s3 cp s3://infra-config/policies/reserved-gpu-pool-3.json s3://infra-backups/policies/reserved-gpu-pool-3-1781234567.json`

devon: Command I'll run (dry-run first):
```
infractl pools update reserved-gpu-pool-3 --policy-file=policies/scaling-v2.json --canary=10 --dry-run
```
Dry-run OK locally, no diffs.

maria: Go/no-go from me: GO. Keep the first evaluation at +20m and post to this thread. If anything odd, escalate to #eng-oncall and ping pager. :rocket: :thumbsup:

aj: On it. I'll post status at +5m and +20m after canary. Tagging @sam @devon for visibility.

sam: Ready.

devon: Ready to execute at 02:30 UTC, will DM if anything unexpected.

maria: Thanks all — keep updates short in this thread so we have a single timeline.
